subject: Evidence orchestration runbook & escalation grid for MSA security exhibit
messages:
From: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwoodinference.com>
To: Samir Patel <s.patel@cedarbridge.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 19 Oct 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Evidence orchestration runbook & escalation grid for MSA security exhibit

Hi Samir —

Thanks again for the productive legal + security sync last week. As discussed, I attached a first-pass "Evidence Orchestration Runbook" that maps SOC 2 assertions, pen-test access expectations, and a pragmatic evidence cadence for high-volume evidence requests during onboarding. The goal is to reduce back-and-forth during procurement while keeping your team in control of sampling and scope.

High-level we propose: 
- SOC 2 evidence buckets (config artifacts, control owner PDFs, sample logs) with a 3-business-day turnaround SLA for routine asks.
- Pen-test windows: 2-week staging window, prefer dated windows with a single 48-hour high-intensity window for active testing.
- Forensic/inspection access: ephemeral staging creds + read-only forensic snapshot; 7-day notice for privileged inspection.
- Escalation grid: Tier 1 (Security ops) → Tier 2 (Legal) → Tier 3 (CTO on-call) with defined response windows in the runbook.

Asks from your side: can you confirm sampling bands (we suggested 5% / 15% / 100% depending on artifact type) and whether CedarBridge requires live access to production systems during pen tests or if staging-only is acceptable?

Attachments: EvidOrch_Runbook_v1.pdf (runbook), PenTest_Window_Proposal.xlsx (proposed windows/calendar). Also shared a Google Drive folder with supporting SOC 2 artifacts for quick review.

If this looks good, we'll route a slim MSA exhibit addendum (security exhibit + inspection cadence) for your legal team to review. Proposed turnaround for legal redlines: 5 business days for first pass.

Thanks,
Evelyn Hart
Head of Assurance Programs
Redwood Inference

--
EvidOrch_Runbook_v1.pdf (attachment)
PenTest_Window_Proposal.xlsx (attachment)

From: Samir Patel <s.patel@cedarbridge.com>
To: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: security@cedarbridge.com
Date: Mon, 19 Oct 2026 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Evidence orchestration runbook & escalation grid for MSA security exhibit

Evelyn —

Appreciate the detailed draft. Quick clarifying Qs from our security team after a quick read: 
1) Sampling bands: can you provide rationale for the 5%/15%/100% buckets and an example mapping (e.g., audit logs → 15%, infra configs → 5%)? We need this to justify to our compliance team.
2) For pen tests: CedarBridge policy prefers production-similar staging but we sometimes require scoped production tests for third-party critical infra. Will Redwood support scoped production tests under a playbook (short lived creds, notification, and rollback plan)?
3) Evidence packaging: do you have a digest/hash process for large logs or PII-redaction guidance in the runbook? We need to avoid receiving raw PII.

Also, Laura — if you can confirm legal's expected redline cadence (we typically need 7 business days for MSA addenda at our side), that helps set expectations.

We can do a quick 30-minute call tomorrow to walk the runbook.

Thanks,
Samir Patel
Sr. Security Manager — CedarBridge Health
security@cedarbridge.com

> Attachment request: could you add a short example mapping table to the runbook?

From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>
To: Samir Patel <s.patel@cedarbridge.com>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 19 Oct 2026 14:25:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Evidence orchestration runbook & escalation grid for MSA security exhibit

Samir / Evelyn —

Thanks — Laura from Legal here. A few notes and commitments from Redwood to make contracting smoother: 

1) Legal turnaround: we'll commit to 3 business days for first-pass redlines on the slim security exhibit addendum, provided the exhibit only contains operational (non-contractual) language. For any change that touches core MSA liability or indemnity we will need our standard review timeline (10 business days).

2) Production pen-test support: Redwood is open to scoped production tests under the following conditions (we'll add this to the runbook):
   - Formal pre-approved playbook (calendar, rollback, point-of-contact)
   - Scoped blast radius (explicitly listed services)
   - Escrowed creds and ephemeral tokens; Redwood engineering will broker the short-lived access.

3) Sampling and PII: Ben, please confirm retention & redaction flow. Our proposed approach in the runbook: hashes and redacted samples for logs (we provide sanitized extracts and verification hashes). Full raw datasets will only be shared under explicit inspection requests and require a dedicated data transfer agreement.

4) Escalation ladder: we'll publish an "escalation grid" in the runbook with SLA bands (24h ops, 48-72h legal, 48h exec triage) and a single escalation alias for your team.

Action items (short):
- Redwood: update runbook with example mapping table + PII redaction flow (Evelyn).
- Redwood Engineering: confirm retention window & hashing (Ben).
- CedarBridge: confirm whether you require production-simulated pen tests or can accept staging-only for initial onboarding (Samir).

I'll aim to get the slim exhibit language drafted and in DocuSign-ready format once we agree on sampling + pen-test scope.

Best,
Laura Bennett
Senior Counsel — Redwood Inference

From: Samir Patel <s.patel@cedarbridge.com>
To: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwoodinference.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 20 Oct 2026 15:07:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Evidence orchestration runbook & escalation grid for MSA security exhibit

Laura / Evelyn —

Thanks — CedarBridge is comfortable with the proposed escalation SLA bands and the idea of hashes/redacted extracts for SOC 2 artifacts. For the pen test approach, we can accept staging-only for the first onboarding round; we will reserve the option to request a scoped production test later in the relationship and will follow the playbook you outlined for that scenario.

We've reviewed the attachments and added two items (see attached PenTest_Window_Proposal.xlsx): 
- Proposed primary window: 2026-11-15 to 2026-11-29 (staging).
- 48-hour active test: 2026-11-18 to 2026-11-19 (high intensity).

Next steps: 
- Eve: please update the runbook with the example mapping table and PII redaction flow.
- Laura: please spin the slim security exhibit addendum and share a DocuSign link; we'll aim for a 7 business day turnaround on our side for this addendum.
- Ben: confirm log retention hashing workflow.

Once we have the DocuSign, I'll route internally and loop in procurement for an order-form signature.

Thanks,
Samir Patel
Sr. Security Manager — CedarBridge Health
security@cedarbridge.com

--
